title: North Korea and South Korea Exchange Military Threats Over DMZ Blast
detail: North Korea and South Korea exchanged military threats following a blast near the DMZ, raising inter-Korean tensions. The incident marks a significant escalation in military posturing along the demilitarized zone.

title: Satellite Imagery Shows Land Clearance at DPRK Facility, May Signal Drone Base Expansion
detail: 38North analysis of commercial satellite imagery reveals land clearance activity at a North Korean facility that could signal an expansion of drone base capabilities. The activity is consistent with preparations for expanded drone operations infrastructure, reflecting North Korea's continued investment in unmanned aerial systems alongside its ballistic missile and nuclear programs.
